question: PM Modi launches global M.S. Swaminathan Award for Food and Peace. Who was the first recipient of the M.S. Swaminathan Award?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Ademola A. Adenle__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• PM Modi launches global M.S. Swaminathan Award for Food and Peace.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Prime Minister Narendra Modi** launched the **M.S. Swaminathan Award for Food and Peace** during the **M.S. Swaminathan Centenary International Conference** in **Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The **award honours contributions to food security and sustainable agriculture**, especially in the **developing world**.

 
 
• 
 
**First recipient**: **Dr. Arenare**, a Nigerian scientist, for efforts in **reducing hunger in Nigeria**.

 
 
• 
 
PM also **released a centenary memorial stamp** to commemorate Prof. Swaminathan’s legacy.

 
 
• 
 
Prof. **M.S. Swaminathan**, known as the **Father of India's Green Revolution**, passed away on **September 23, 2023**, aged 98.

 
 
• 
 
He was **posthumously awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2024**.

 
 
• 
 
His work led to **India’s food self-sufficiency** during the **1960s–70s**, transforming agriculture through **science and innovation**.
